what: The round shadows under the feet of four small pictures scattered around the text spread first from 0 to 1.1x wide in .6s (easeInQuad, .15s apart in turn), then wobble on a spring and settle at 1x (.8s). Starting .8s later the pictures appear one by one .2s apart, floating up 8px (.2s) and settling down (.6s) — once when the section’s top edge rises 400px above the bottom of the screen

options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom-=400 (phone top bottom-=write it as 200)
options.pic-delay: Time until the first image appears (sec), default .8
options.[data-fx-part=shadow]: Round shadow under the feet — color and size are set in the consumer’s css

from.where: index.html .sk-lead (four spring/summer/autumn/winter pictures around the pledge text, with shadows under their feet. Original init.js top-lead: when scroll ≥ top edge − screen + 400, shadow scaleX 1.1·scaleY 1 600ms easeInQuad (150ms each) → scaleX 1 800ms spring, img opacity 1·translateY −8 200ms (after 800·1000·1200·1400ms) → 0 600ms easeInOutQuad)

note: spring uses the named curve of velocity 1.x, 1 − cos(4.5πp)·e^(−6p), as-is as a function curve
